sources.title: Run Qwen3.8 Flash Next Uncensored Locally - Atomic Chat
sources.snippet: Qwen3.8 Flash Next Uncensored is the community-edited, abliterated version of Alibaba's Qwen3.8 Flash Next: the same 125B Mixture-of-Experts model, with the refusal behavior taken out of the weights. This guide covers the builds worth running, how much memory each one needs, and the exact setup for both Atomic Chat and llama.cpp.
